card.line: Bezek was a city where Judah defeated the Canaanites and later where Saul gathered Israel's army to rescue Jabesh-gilead.

moments.title: Judah wins at Bezek
moments.text: Judah attacked, and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands. They struck down ten thousand men at Bezek and found Adoni-bezek there.

moments.title: Saul counts the army
moments.text: Saul numbered the men of Israel at Bezek. There were 300,000 Israelites and 30,000 men of Judah. The next day Saul led them against the Ammonites, and the LORD worked salvation in Israel.
